messages:
alex: LAN tonight @channel — thinking a low-key 'Rogue Rumble' in the office lounge, 7pm. I can bring PS5 + Switch. Need someone to bring a router and some power strips. Who's in? :hand:
lina: In! I can bring an 8-port switch and a long ethernet cable (25ft). No router though.
sam: I have two power strips and an extension cord. Also bringing my gaming chair. :sunglasses:
jordan: I can bring my portable router (TP-Link). Also have a couple spare Cat6 cables. Anyone need HDMI adapters? My Switch dock is flaky.
alex: Legend. @jordan can you set up a guest wifi (LAN2026)? Also can someone pick up pizza? I'm allergic to mushrooms so no mushrooms pls.
tara: Happy to grab 2 large pizzas. Veg + pepperoni okay? :pizza:
devops-bot: event created "LAN: Rogue Rumble" — reminder set for 6:30pm. Room reserved: 3rd floor lounge.
sam: Veg + pepperoni works for me. @mike do you have extra controllers? We need 2 more for the tourney.
mike: I have one extra Xbox pad and a Switch Pro. Might be able to borrow a PS4 pad if needed. Where should I drop them?
lina: Drop them at the front desk and tag me, I'll collect before 6:45.
alex: Awesome. Quick note: bring surge protectors if you can — we had a brownout last time. Please label your gear so it doesn't wander.
jordan: :thumbsup: I'll bring surge strips and a small switch. Setup idea: 2 stations — 'tourney' (Smash) + 'chaos lounge' (couch coop roguelikes). Thoughts?
tara: Love that. I'll sign people up at arrival. Also we should try to stream the main match.
alex: Sign me up for both. I can try to run OBS if we have 2 laptops. Need someone to manage chat/scene switching.
sam: I can stream from my laptop but need a 10ft USB-C -> HDMI. Bringing snacks too (chips + soda).
mike: I'll bring a spare capture cable and a mic. If needed I can handle scene switching.
alex: Perfect — sounds like a plan. See y'all at 7. If anything changes ping in here. :raised_hands:
